title: Treat continuous observations as evidence rather than execution authority
summary: A periodic collector may propose work through reviewed scoped rules, while durable episode identity and native admission preserve authorization and deduplication.
reusable_steps: A periodic collector may propose work through reviewed scoped rules, while durable episode identity and native admission preserve authorization and deduplication
expected_outcome: Collect only bounded numeric observations with original timestamps and evidence references. Validate all sources and exact tier, tenant, organization and project before updating state or admitting work. Keep source acquisition separate from deterministic policy. Persist episode identity before admission, reconcile uncertain admission with the same identity, and require explicit recovery for definitive refusal. Preserve previous work references after metric recovery so feedback remains visible. Capacity exhaustion defers new admission without spending episode identity. A metric improvement is an observation, not proof of a causal effect.
